entries.target: 扰乱主动技能，使其进入冷却。

entries.source: The poison spore looks somewhat drained.
entries.target: 毒性孢子看起来有些枯竭了。

entries.source: Cold flames start to appear around @target@.
Cold flames slowly spread from %d spots within radius %d, The flames deal %d cold damage with a chance to freeze.
entries.target: 冷焰从半径%d格范围内的%d处地点缓慢扩散，火焰造成%d点寒冷伤害并有几率冻结目标。

entries.source: A stream of acid gushes onto @target@!
A bolt of fire blasts onto @target@!
A bolt of ice blasts onto @target@!
A bolt of lightning fires onto @target@!
A stream of poison gushes onto @target@!
A bolt of fire fires onto @target@!
Deals up to %d manaburn damage, draining mana, vim, and positive and negative energies within radius %d.
entries.target: 在%d格范围内最多造成%d点法力燃烧伤害，并吸取法力值、活力值以及正负能量。

entries.source: A powerful blast of fire impacts @target@!
All within radius %d are dealt %d fire damage, set on fire for %d more fire damage over 3 turns, and may be stunned.
entries.target: %d格范围内的所有目标受到%d火焰伤害，在3回合内额外受到%d燃烧伤害，并有几率被震慑。

entries.source: A motile vine that strikes out for %s%d#LAST# %s damage.
entries.target: 一团活动的藤蔓，打击目标造成%s%d#LAST#%s伤害。

entries.source: Teleports the victim away.  How does anyone get close enough to disarm this trap...?
entries.target: 将目标传送走。到底要怎样才能靠近并解除这个陷阱……？

entries.source: @Target@ is caught in a distorted pocket of time!
Creates a temporal anomaly when triggered.
@Target@ is caught in an extremely distorted pocket of time!
Creates a major temporal anomaly when triggered.
entries.target: 触发时制造大型时空异常。
